name: alpaca-trading-bot
description: AI-powered autonomous daytrading bot using Alpaca API

scripts.db:verify:crypto-reservations:remote: wrangler d1 execute alpaca-trading-bot --remote --command="SELECT type, name, tbl_name FROM sqlite_master WHERE name IN ('crypto_entry_reservations', 'idx_crypto_entry_reservations_expiry') ORDER BY name;"
scripts.db:verify:trade-intent:remote: wrangler d1 execute alpaca-trading-bot --remote --command="SELECT name, type FROM pragma_table_info('trades') WHERE name IN ('intent_stop_loss_price', 'intent_take_profit_price') ORDER BY name;"
